pkgmetadata.longdescription: pahole (dwarves) with the merged-compilation-unit --lang_exclude fixes needed by Rust modules built with LLVM LTO and BTF, installed under /usr/libexec/pahole-cachyos so it can coexist with dev-util/pahole. The kernel ebuilds point the kernel build at this copy directly. Upstream series: https://lore.kernel.org/dwarves/CAPLSpGbV5RTSuMZPX=UgzniPtoT7jup7pCGw_Rt2tqiejKXmng@mail.gmail.com/
